title: upstream crosslink: 0.8.0 sync writes .last-hydrated-ref, .promoted-uuids, promotion-log.json with no ignore coverage in its own managed block
description: After this repo's first hub sync (crosslink 0.8.0, 2026-07-20), three machine-local state files sat untracked and unignored: .crosslink/.last-hydrated-ref, .crosslink/.promoted-uuids, .crosslink/promotion-log.json. Neither the managed .gitignore block init deploys (src/commands/init/merge.rs in the local mirror) nor the inner .crosslink/.gitignore lists them — the sync/promotion machinery gained state files without the ignore templates keeping up, so every fresh adopter repo shows perpetual untracked noise after first sync. Suggestion: add the three entries to the managed block template (or the inner .crosslink/.gitignore, matching .hub-cache/'s home). Interim in this repo: ignored in a project-owned section outside the managed markers, noted to migrate on upstream absorption. Evidence: git status of this repo post-sync, 2026-07-20; mirror source grep showing no template coverage.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: HELD: operator directive 2026-07-20 (recorded as an intervention on vsdd-cli #597) — upstream-filing block pending operator information about the upstream project from an mdatron kickoff run. This issue is a local relay record in this repo's tracker only; no upstream communication has occurred. Disposition awaits the operator's information.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Closed as fixed-upstream: commit f391886f (PRs #778/#779) added .last-hydrated-ref, .promoted-uuids, and promotion-log.json to both the managed .gitignore block (merge.rs:23-25) and the inner .crosslink/.gitignore template (mod.rs:1029-1031) at main 85691369. Fix postdates 0.8.0; this repo's project-owned ignore section (commit 3fe10ac) remains the operative cover until the pinned binary (NO-GO, decision on #597) is eventually upgraded and deploys the new block.
